#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
int base, exponent;

int power_mod(int base, int exp)
{
    if (exp == 1) return base;
    int half = power_mod(base, exp / 2);
    long long result = (1LL * half * half) % MOD;
    if (exp % 2 == 0) return (int)result;
    return (int)((result * base) % MOD);
}

int main()
{
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cout.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> base >> exponent;

    if (exponent == 0)
    {
        cout << power_mod(base, base - 1);
        return 0;
    }

    if (exponent == 1)
    {
        cout << power_mod(base, base);
        return 0;
    }

    int multiple = 1;
    int temp = exponent;
    while (true)
    {
        multiple++;
        temp = (1LL * temp * exponent) % base;
        if (temp == 1)
        {
            cout << power_mod(base, (base - 1) / multiple);
            return 0;
        }
    }

    return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
